kindling_grey.name: Grey Kindling
kindling_grey.lore: Ash-coloured wood that has forgotten how to burn. The Hearth will remember for it.

kindling_green.name: Green Kindling
kindling_green.lore: Still sap-wet, cut from a tree that never asked to die. It will hiss before it catches.

kindling_red.name: Red Kindling
kindling_red.lore: Stained dark at one end. Whatever it was pulled from, it was not a tree.

sluice_wheel.name: Sluice Wheel
sluice_wheel.lore: Rusted iron, heavier than it looks. Someone drained the pond on purpose.

storm_lantern.name: Storm Lantern
storm_lantern.lore: Its glass is cracked and its flame leans toward Hollowmere's low places, as if listening.

bell_rope.name: Bell Rope
bell_rope.lore: Frayed hemp from the chapel tower. The bell has not rung since the water left.

castle_key.name: Castle Key
castle_key.lore: Cold even in a warm hand. The lord of Hollowmere locked his gate from the inside.

name_fragment_crypt.name: Name Fragment (Crypt)
name_fragment_crypt.lore: A syllable scratched into a coffin lid. The dead kept what the living let go.

name_fragment_shrine.name: Name Fragment (Shrine)
name_fragment_shrine.lore: Pressed into cold wax at a candle shrine. The Wick left it here and kept walking.

name_fragment_windmill.name: Name Fragment (Windmill)
name_fragment_windmill.lore: Carved into a sail that no longer turns. The wind in Hollowmere has nothing left to say.

torch.name: Torch
torch.lore: A borrowed flame. It burns a little faster the closer you carry it to the drained pond.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.lore: Its head is pitted from striking things that were not nails. Walls, mostly. Some bone.

sword.name: Sword
sword.lore: Notched and honest. Whoever carried it before you did not come back for it.
